desc: a skeletal gravedigger: a tall gaunt figure in a long black robe and a wide-brimmed black hat, a BONE-WHITE skull face (never green), BONE-WHITE skeletal hands (never green), a long scythe carried in one hand, and a hanging lantern with AMBER-ORANGE glass at his belt. The ONLY light in the design is that amber lantern flame -- there is NO green anywhere on this character, not on the skull, not on the hands, not in the lantern
